name: light_spear_launch
for: angel_priest lance of light / the_archangel spear of light, the throw at the hand (art throw)
notes: One-shot at the throwing hand: gold motes gather into the palm (frames 1-3), a hard white-gold cross flash with a long tapered spike of light shooting forward (+x) along the throw line, two or three pale feathers shed and drifting down, sparkles blinking out. Drawn at the priest's 53.3 px/m; for the archangel (45.8) draw at x0.86 or as is.
